title: SU-ESRGAN: Semantic and Uncertainty-Aware ESRGAN for Super-Resolution of Satellite and Drone Imagery with Fine-Tuning for Cross Domain Evaluation
reasoning: The paper describes a technical framework for image super-resolution in remote sensing. While it briefly mentions ethical concerns such as unauthorized surveillance and deceptive content as motivation for providing uncertainty maps, it does not evaluate or benchmark topics related to religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
